result.topic_en: The page ends a remark on higher-than-quadratic forms, outlines extending Minkowski's theorem on integral substitutions to substitutions with algebraic integer coefficients using congruences modulo a prime ideal, and begins a note on Gauss's choice of arguments for mechanical quadrature.
